name: Luka Dončić
title: The step-back three
steps: The defender has to respect the drive.
He crosses it back to his left and hops into the shot.
A high release over the closeout.
aria: Animated illustration of Luka Dončić's step-back three: he jabs toward the basket so the defender backs off, crosses the ball back between his legs to his left as he hops back behind the three-point line, then rises and releases over a late closeout. An original drawing, not traced from footage, not to scale.
